content.value: A counter flow double pipe heat exchanger is to heat water from $2 0 \textdegree C$ to $8 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ at a rate of 1.2kg/s. The heating is to be accomplished by geothermal water available at $1 6 0 \%$ at a mass flow rate of 2 kg/s. The inner tube is thin-walled and has a diameter of 1.5 cm. If the overall heat transfer coefficient of the heat exchanger is 640 $W / m ^ { 2 } . ^ { \circ } C ,$ determine the length of the heat exchanger required to achieve the desired heating.
